MethodTask 1

1Tie-point clusters

Table 2 with the 23 Nov masks (water SIC ≤ 1 %, SST > 273 K, |lat| > 55°; ice TB > 180 K; both: lsm = 0 and ≤ 10 % land in the 5×5 box). Tap the layer to see each criterion or compare with the 20 Nov masks.

2Raw SIC

Eq. 16: SIC = (TB − Tp,water) / (Tp,ice − Tp,water), tie points = cluster means of step 1, no correction.

3RTM correction ΔTB

Select an input below to use these views. Value – input at the pixel · Difference – pixel minus reference · Effect – ΔTB from this input alone

Eq. 13–14. Bar = typical size of the effect on this day.

Cloud water L · not corrected

L goes into both model runs with the same value, so it cancels in ΔTB.
Reference weather = (1 − SIC) · water-cluster mean + SIC · ice-cluster mean, with the SIC of the previous iteration (iteration 1: ERA5 siconc), clipped to 0–100 %.

4Corrected SIC

Eq. 13 + 16: SIC from TB + ΔTB with tie points from the corrected clusters.
